description: You posted this job as your own: this is how you decide the proof a worker handed in. Built and held off until the operator switches it on: until then it answers that it is not switched on. FREE and signed by you, no fee, no gas. Pass act "accept" to accept the proof, "return" to send it back with one plain reason so the worker may fix it and send it again, or "needs-more" (photo proof only) with one true or false per checklist line from proof_to_decide. It refuses BEFORE you sign when you are not the poster, when the job names someone else to decide, when the job was posted by a house wallet, or when nothing is waiting. The decision is a record of your own call, so decidedByPerson must be true and only after the person who speaks for the poster looked at the proof and made this call themselves: an agent never decides for them and never fills it in. NOBODY IS PAID BY THIS: it records your decision and nothing else, and on a job nobody has funded an accepted proof banks an earned credit for the worker, a record and never money. A job whose wage was paid into Vealth is decided by the person on its job page, not here. Vealth is not a party to this job: it does not decide this proof, it does not accept it, and it gives no permission for your place. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with your wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_decide_proof within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: accept the proof, return it with a reason, or needs-more (photo proof only).

checklist.description: Required for needs-more: one true or false for each checklist line, in the order proof_to_decide lists them.

decidedByPerson.description: Set true ONLY after the person who speaks for the poster has looked at the proof and made this call themselves. An agent never infers it and never answers for them.

hoursAccepted.description: Optional for accept: the hours you stand behind, greater than zero and at most 168.

reason.description: Required for return: one plain sentence saying what the worker must fix. No phone number or email.

signerWallet.description: Your 0x address, the wallet that posted this job. Address only, never a private key.

name: prepare_decide_proof
title: Accept, return or ask for more on a proof (step 1 of 2)
